name: Cove Point Pipeline 2008 Expansion

values.OtherEnglishNames: Dominion Cove Point PL 2008 Expansion; TL-532 loop
values.EndLocation: Cove Point LNG terminal, Calvert County

researcher_notes: Checked against the roster: P0176 is the 6059 km Dominion Gas Pipeline system row and P2630 is the West Loop Expansion. No row covers this Cove Point loop, so it is a new expansion row, not a match. The EIA release of August 2026 (sheet Historical Projects, Excel row 569) lists Dominion Cove Point PL 2008 Expansion: 47.8 miles of 36 inch pipe in Maryland, 800 MMcf/d added, completed 15 December 2008, cost 159.8 million dollars (staged 159800000 USD), FERC docket CP05-132. A Federal Register site visit notice of 25 May 2005 confirms the docket and a proposed TL-532 pipeline loop in Calvert County, Maryland, as part of Dominion's Cove Point expansion; it does not state length or diameter, so it supports only the endpoint region. Length is from EIA alone. Web search of the FERC environmental review summary mentioned about 41 miles of 36 inch loop in Maryland, which differs from EIA's 47.8; not opened or verified, so a person should check against the FERC order. Length of 47.8 miles is about 77 km, above the 25 km threshold. Sponsor is Dominion Cove Point LNG, which the ownership list spells Cove Point LNG LP. PipelineName follows P0176's roster name; a person should confirm that Cove Point's pipeline is part of that system row, since it is a separate FERC-regulated company. No route found; no official GIS was searched. Confidence medium: one data source for the numbers.
